regressionCoverage.keyboard: Simulator UI verifies that the chat adds no Done keyboard toolbar, dismisses the real keyboard through history taps, controls and dragging, and retains the draft.
regressionCoverage.reactionPlacement: Five native geometry tests cover 320- and 393-point viewports, both message alignments, below-at-top and above-at-bottom placement, tall message clamping and expanded menu height.
regressionCoverage.longPress: Simulator UI verifies six non-overlapping reaction controls in one 286-by-54-point bar, with a separate compact Copy panel above the composer; manual fixture callbacks exercise pending selection, failure, retry, confirmation and removal.
regressionCoverage.copyAndDismissal: Simulator UI verifies that Copy closes the menu without requesting a reaction or opening the message, that the same message can reopen it, and that a backdrop tap over the composer dismisses without opening the keyboard.
regressionCoverage.doubleTap: Simulator UI requests a heart without opening the card, closes the keyboard and retains the draft; only a simulated confirmed response reveals the selected heart.
regressionCoverage.latestMessage: Simulator UI verifies the compact latest-message button, visible scroll position, older-message reading after an append, and return to the latest message.
regressionCoverage.nativeAudioControls: Simulator UI exercises a synthetic native play-button action and scrolling inside the production reaction wrapper; no physical recording or live audio playback is claimed.

validationLimits: Reaction UI tests use synthetic data and manual confirmation callbacks, not authenticated live backend requests.
Backend reaction authorization and persistence are tested separately with SQL and S3 fixtures.
Simulator tests do not verify physical microphone/camera, GPS, APNs delivery, the physical WidgetKit compositor or effective display refresh rate.
This CI result does not establish Apple processing or TestFlight availability for build 11.1.
